title: Wall Street is DEAD WRONG on Meta... Buy THIS Instead
speaker: Ross Givens

macro_themes.view: AI agents like Meta's Muse will pay via regulated digital dollars; GENIUS Act enforcement Jan 18 forces stablecoin reserves into Treasuries.
Fed hiked Sep 16 with another hike likely; 2y yield prices 3-5 more hikes and 3-month bills heading to ~4.5%.

calls.reason: Circle earns T-bill interest on ~$75B USDC; an extra point of yield adds ~$300M profit (~66% EPS jump) while agentic AI grows stablecoin demand.
calls.quote: I'm guessing more probably a lot more and this stock is going to make money every time they do.

calls.reason: Muse added ~$550B of market cap but faces privacy problems and will probably fail like earlier Zuckerberg products; the value accrues to payment rails.
calls.quote: this one will probably fail. And it won't matter.

calls.reason: Cheap at 9.5x earnings and a Muse checkout option, but cheap for a reason: users have moved to Venmo, Zelle and Cash App.
calls.quote: the obvious play here is PayPal. It's not the right one

notes: No date stated; listing date used. CRCL price 'mid 80s' recorded as 85; notes it nearly hit 300 last year but no target given. META bias is the title's 'Wall Street is wrong' thesis, not an explicit short.
